vulnerability_analysis: The contract owner can abuse their privilege by setting _maxTxAmount to 1 wei via setMaxTxAmount(1). This effectively blocks all user transactions (since they're limited to 1 wei transfers) while the owner remains exempt from this limit. This is a classic owner privilege abuse/DOS attack.
attack_strategy: 1. Become the contract owner by overwriting the owner storage slot. 2. Call setMaxTxAmount(1) to set the maximum transaction amount to 1 wei. 3. Verify the attack succeeded by checking _maxTxAmount == 1.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.store() to overwrite storage slot 0 of the target contract with our address (attacker) to become the owner. 2. Impersonate ourselves as the new owner using vm.prank(). 3. Call setMaxTxAmount(1) on the target contract. 4. Read the _maxTxAmount public variable to verify it's now 1.
